description: The table as it stands, in words: the clock, the pool, both chains, your hand, the market, the columns, the last events, and every legal action as a numbered line. Waits up to wait_seconds (at most 50) for your action when it is theirs; if it is still theirs, call table_state again.

wait_seconds.description: wait for your action this long (default 40, at most 50)

name: table_state
